name: @cboxdk/cms-ui-kit
description: The component kit of the Cbox CMS panel (working name, GUARDRAILS 8: one kit, no stand-alone components). Its design tokens come from tokens.json, the single source of src/tokens.css, the TypeScript names and the JSON Schema of a theme (npm run generate:tokens); its stylesheets sit in the cascade layers that src/layers.css declares; its own texts come from its da and en catalogues through KitI18nProvider; and it builds on React Aria's headless, accessible primitives, which stay internal to it.
